content:
**Route 98** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*.

A roadway in the northern Savage Divide. It runs west to east, starting at an intersection with Route 95 south of the Palace of the Winding Path. It passes Sunnytop Ski Lanes Base Lodge and the Converted Munitions Factory, before terminating at the intersection of Highwy 63 and Highway 66, west of the Red Rocket Mega Stop.

Route 98 appears in *Fallout 76*.
